packageRules.description: golangci-lint is pinned in .forgejo/workflows/ci.yml (see the comment there, and #315). It is the LINTER, so an upgrade can turn the tree red without a single line of ours changing — which is why it must arrive as its own PR that can be read, rather than grouped with unrelated Go modules or landing silently as @latest.

customManagers.description: Keep the pinned golangci-lint in the CI workflow up to date. It is installed with `go install ...@vX.Y.Z` rather than declared in go.mod, so no standard manager can see it — without this the pin would simply rot, which is the failure mode that replaces the one #315 fixed.
